# PICO8-OS firmware config. See https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/config_txt.html

# A/B system slots: slot.txt holds "os_prefix=a/" or "os_prefix=b/", which
# selects the kernel, cmdline.txt, DTBs and overlays of that slot. OTA updates
# write the inactive slot and then flip this one line.
include slot.txt
start_file=start4.elf
fixup_file=fixup4.dat
kernel=zImage
arm_64bit=0

# Fast, quiet boot
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
# full CPU clock for the first 60 s (kernel + PICO-8 start), then normal policy
initial_turbo=60
# higher default clock on Pi 4 boards that support it (firmware decides)
arm_boost=1
disable_overscan=1

# KMS display driver (required for SDL2 kmsdrm) + audio
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2
dtparam=audio=on

gpu_mem_256=64
gpu_mem_512=64
gpu_mem_1024=64

# Serial console on GPIO14/15 (serial0). Bluetooth keeps the PL011 UART,
# which it needs to be reliable; enable_uart=1 pins the mini-UART clock.
enable_uart=1
